Theorem
[Classification of closed hyperbolic foliations] 1. Theorem 4.9\group foliations Source: thurston:page-0075, thurston:page-0081 For a hyperbolic foliation of a closed three-manifold, either the holonomy group is discrete and the developing map descends to a Seifert fibration over $\HH ^2/H(\pi _1M)$, or the manifold fibers over $S^1$ with torus fiber.
